name: Beijing Relpow Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Beijing Relpow Technology Co., Ltd engages in the manufacture and sale of power supply products in China and internationally. It provides special power management chips, motor driver chips, integrated circuit micromodules, motor drive modules, motor controllers, and motor equipment. The company offers DC-DC module power supply, AC-DC module power supply, POE power supply, embedded power system, AC-DC and DC-DC server power supply, communication rectifier, and micropower supplies. It serves communication and network, rail transit power supply, industrial power, security power, aviation, aerospace, vehicles, ships, and special power supplies fields.
